tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 331)༄༅/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye/rab 'byams rgyud dang sgru
331)༄༅/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye/rab 'byams rgyud dang sgru

tei:div.tei:p: 331) ༄༅/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye/ rab 'byams rgyud dang sgrub sdai'i yang zhun mchog /bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma// rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar// gus pas phyag 'tshal bka' yi gnang ba stsol/

de la lha sras 'bring po dam 'dzin mu rub btsad po'i rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i zab gter bla ma dgongs 'dus gser chos kyi sgrub chen 'don 'grigs sras slob brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byung ba bzhin 'bri ba la/ thog mar sna sel du rnam 'joms sme brtsegs la sogs pa'i khrus/ ltung bshags dang rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ mngon rtogs ltar srung 'khor/ brgya bzhi/ sdong brgyan/ kha 'bar/ sher snying ste brgya 'gyur mdos dkar bzhi'am/ lan chags brgya bsngo/ dam sri glud mdos rdzongs/ bka' brgyad dam phur pa'i zlog chung*/ dri med bshags rgyud klogs/ zhi bsang snang gsum/ sde brgyad khengs mdos/ cha gsum dang sde brgyad cha snyoms grang gsog dang rgyal po gsol 'gyogs/ zhi drag gi sbyin sreg gang 'grub bcas dang*/ shar du sher phyin/ lhor mtshan brjod/ nub tu bkra shis brtsegs pa/ byang du yum chen mo'i mtshan brgya rnams bklag go ༈ sa chog ni/ hrīḥ sngon gyi= spos phyung*/ mngon rtogs ltar/ na mo/ rkang gnyis gtso bo= 'byung bar shog= bar lan gsum/ rtse le dang*/ bya khyung gang rung gi sngon 'gro gtor ma byin rlabs/ oṃ badzra yakṣa= sogs/ sngags rnams gsum re/ 332) bya khyung sa chog las/ rang nyid skad cig gi padma badzra rtsal= sogs nas/ gtor ma dang po/ khā hi= bar/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ a ka ro= lan gsum/ pra khrid ces pa sgrub khog yin pas/ de ltar lha klu sa dag= nas/ khā hi= bar/ gtor ma gsum pa/ sa sa chog ltar bhu mi pa ti= lan gsum/ 'dzam gling bstan 'dzin= sogs nas/ bdag gi bsam pa'i= sogs/ slar/ bhu mi pa ti= sngon tshe bcom ldan= sogs gtor ma gsum ka gshegs/ yungs dkar dang dri bzang gi chu 'thor/ gu gul bdug cing*/ bhruṃ bi shwa= ldan par gyur= bar/ stegs bu de nyid du ma traṃ bkod nas/ spro na gtong thung dang*/ las byang chen mo tshangs sgra ltar mkhyen gzu dpang gsol/

hrīḥgadod nas rnam dag= nas/ phrin las mdzod: bar/ bsdu na mi dgos/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mgrin dregs pa pho rgyud thams cad kyi che btsan= sogs mngon rtogs chen mo ltar la/ cha lugs su gnas par gyur= bar/ sa chog las/ dkyil 'khor pa mi dmigs pa las= sogs/ hūm̐ he ru= sogs/ mā ra ya dzaḥ bar/ bden stobs mthar/ sgrub pa zab mo= sogs/ ma traṃ= kha bsgyur can lan gsum/ ging 'cham dang bsgrags te sa/ hūm̐:ma traṃ bya ba'i= nas/ garbha tsakra hūm̐: zhes pas bsgral la/ ging ldog tshar nas/ bhruṃ bi shwa= nas/ maṇḍal hūm̐: bum gter sba ba/ hūm̐:bla ma bde shegs= nas/ pha la hūm̐: shis pa brjod/ slob dpon dbus su/ slob ma rnams kyis bskor nas/ mchod phreng ltar/ lce lag rdor dril mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ mngon rtogs kyi/ na mo:rkang gnyis gtso bo= nas/skyabs sems yan bdun tshar nas/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi= sogs/ der gsal ltar mngon rtogs dang sprad nas/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa/ bstod pa zin nas/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar= spyi dril 'bring po bzla/ 333) gtso bos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ= sogs brjod/ e ma ho: ma lus= sogs/ phyogs so sor gsol gdab dang*/ hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha= sogs nas/ bgegs bskrad/ phur pa bskyed/ rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥ bar/ rgyal tho ni/ oṃ swa bhā= sogs/ bya khyung ltar/ gzhung gsal shar lho nub byang tshar nas/ bsdus pa dor/ dam sri mnan pa dang sgo byang gnyis slob ma sta gon gyi gong du bya bar gsungs kyang 'dir yi ge'i 'gros ltar byas na/ gser skyems rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud dang*/ e yam̐ dzwa la ram̐: brub khung las kyi gshin rje= sogs tshangs sgra'i tshogs skabs kyihom bskyed/ srog zan rnams kyi go rar gyur pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo sngo la rid pa= sogs nas/ gzugs can du gyur= rang yi dam= nas/ sa gzugs la bstim= spyi 'gugs la/ sgrub pa zab mo= gzhung gsal sbyar ba gsum/

bden chung*/ rtsa rgyud/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba= las bzhi bcas sgo byang gzhung gsal ltar btang*/ 'dul du gsol: bar/ sgo 'di yan chad du su yang ma 'da' zhig: zhes brjod/ nang du log nas/ ༈ lha sta gon ni/ spro na lha sngags rgyas pa/ bsdu na gtso dgu'i sngags kyi tshom bu dgaud/ bum pa sta gon sngags rnams bum sgrub bam chog bsgrigs ltar/ oṃ āḥbighnan= sogs nas/ st+wam̐: bar/ slar gtso dgu las sngags bcas brjod pas stegs la dgaud/ me phreng bgegs bskrad nas bstod pa yan/ bya khyung bdag bskyed bsnyen dmigs/ lha rnams kyi= sogs nas 'bru gsum dang spyi dril nyung ba bzla/ bya khyung chog 'phros/ hoḥdagongs su gsol lo bla ma yi dam= nas/ mdzad du gsol: bar lan gsum/ de nas bum bskyed tse le'i dkyil 334) chog gi oṃ badzra yakṣa= sogs nas/ gzhung gsal zur byang sbyar/ spyan 'dren sogs gong gi mdun bskyed nang ltar blang*/ mchod pa gong 'og gnyis gang rung gcig bstod pa/ bzlas dmigs bsnyen pa/ las bum bdud 'khyil/ dung zhal/ mdzad du gsol: bar/ mdun bskyed tse le ltar/ oṃ swa bhāwa= sogs nas zhi khro ma gtogs spyan 'dren dbang bskur yan chad zin nas/ khrus gsol mi dgos/ bum dbang las chu bzhi 'bul sngags dang*/ 'og gi mchod pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes bdud rtsi= sogs phyi mchod tshar nas tshangs sgra'i nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba/ bstod pa bcas grub nas/ gtso dgu'i sngags dang spyi dril che 'bring cung zad bzla/ mtshams phur/ sumbha ni= byug bdug brab/ bskyed mchog zur gsal ltar ram yang na/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phur bu rnams hūm̐ yig bcu las stod khro bo smad phur pa'i rnam pa can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa badzra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa= lta bus bstod/

tshangs sgra'i gsang mtshams skabs ltar khro bcu'i sngags dang*/ rten snying bzla/ sta gon rdzas bzhi las sngags dang 'bru gsum kyis byin rlab/ rta sha btsan gsum gyi gtor 'bul chags med gsung dang*/ me phreng ltar tshogs/ skong ba/ lhag ma bcas zin nas/ dam sri mnan pa/ sgo byang btags pa sngar ma song na 'dir bya/ slob ma sta gon ni/ khrus dang*/ me thun chu thun bcas bya/ nang du 'khod nas dgongs 'dus rang gzhung sbyin sreg gam/ chags med spros med zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ 335) dril phyis chang bu dor stabs bum dbang ltar/ bdag dang bdag cag= sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:bgegs dang= sogs dang*/ gang dag gnod byed 'byung po= sogs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags rol mo dang bcas pas bskrad/ ging gtor gru gsum sha khrag mtsho yungs brgyan pa bshams la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dur khrod= sogs/ sgrub khang nyul: zhes pa'i mtshams su bshugs pa rkang gling rol mo bcas ging mchams dang sbrags nas/ rnal 'byor gdung bas= mthar rol mo sngags sgra bshugs pa bcas gtor zor 'phang sar rgyugs/ rgyal theb bzhengs nas dbyangs rol bcas khro bcu phur pa gdab/ ye dhar= bkra shis bcas yang na khro bcu 'dir dor nas rgyan bkod skabs gtong chog pas/ de'i tshab tu tshangs sgra'i srung 'khor/ hūm̐:dur khrod gsang ba= nas/ ku ru hūm̐: bar btang la/ phyag 'tshal rjes zlos/ maṇḍal tshul bdun las 'byung ba ltar rgyas par 'bul/ slar dbang gzhung maṇḍal tshar gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ kye kye rigs kyi bu= nas/ gdon mi za'o: bar kun slong bcos nas/ gsol gdab/ dbang bskur bya ba/ skyabs 'gro/ sems skyed/ sdom gzung*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ rdor sems sgom lung*/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ so shing dor ba ni/ bya khyung sngon 'gro'i tshon byin rlabs las/ swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las dbus su seng ge= sogs nas bstod pa yan/ dbang gzhung ltar so shing sbyin cing dor/

dal gyi lha mi dmigs par gshegs/ khyor chu/ srung skud/ ku sha 'os su gyur pa'o: 336) bar/ shis brjod dang*/ dge bsngo bcas grol/ de nas tshogs drang lhag gong du ma song na 'dir bya/ dkar gtor rtsa rgyud/ me phreng chad brtan rta bro yan/ slob dpon rdor dṛl spos bcas dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing*/ bya khyung sngon 'gro'i 'don 'phros/ hūm̐ hrīḥ padma badzra= nas/ byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol: zhes pa'i bar phyogs bzhi nas tshar re zin nas gral du 'khod/ me phreng ngam chog bsgrigs kyi mchod pa byin brlabs/ mchod phreng ga ི bdud rtsi 'jam legs= sogs sho lo ka gnyis dang*/ mngon rtogs nas/ me tog bdug spos= nas/ bstod pa yan/ sngon 'gro'i 'phros/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha badzra= sogs nas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i chag chag thig gdab mngon rtogs dang spel lung gzhung gsal/ tshon byin rlabs mtha' bar btang*/ me phreng ltar/ nongs bshags/ bkra shis/ bdag bskyed bsdu ba/ rgyal dkyil= bcas byas pas nyin dang po grub/ phyi nyin bdag bskyed gter chen rgyun khyer ram/ skyabs sems yan bdun spyi 'gro dang*/ chags med rtsa tshig bsnyen pa bcas grub nas/ rgyan bkod ni/ pra khrid las/ hūm̐:bum ma zlum po= nas lha bkod sogs/ rgyan rdzas bkod pa'i/ brten par bzhugs su gsol: bar/ dbang nang khro bcu ma song na/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor sgrub= sogs nas/ rten snying*/ ye dhar= bar 'dir blangs na stabs shin tu bde/ hūm̐:thugs rje= sogs nas/ brtan par bzhugs: bar dang*/ mnga' gsol rgyan btags 'dir blang na/ gtong mthun bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ston pa kun tu bzang po= 337) sogs nas/ rgyan gdags/ brda sgo/ brda phyag byin 'bebs mtha' bar/ spro na sgrub khog byin 'bebs mgor/ ratna'i rig 'dzin byin 'bebs gtang*/ 'di nyin dngos gzhi'i thun bzhag na 'di mtshams chos spyod bton tshe gzhung bsrong tho gsos la phebs/ las byang tshogs bskang tshar gcig gtong lugs 'og nas yar blang dgos/

zhag gis bcad na/ me phreng ltar nongs bshags/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang*/ bkra shis sogs bya'o/ dngos gzhi'i nyin la/ mchod phreng las/ oṃ bi shuddhe= sogs lce lag rdor dril byin rlabs/ hūm̐ āḥ bar/ hrīḥsngon= chog bsgrigs mchod pa byin rlabs/ spos phyuung*/ mngon rtogs las skyabs yul/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i= sogs/ dmigs: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ oṃ na mo hūm̐= nas/ ngang la gnas: bar/ mngon rtogs las/ na mo:rkang gnyis= nas/ myur thob shog: bar/ mchod phreng las/ na mo:rkang gnyis gtso bo= nas/ btson par gyi: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ oṃ āḥhūm̐= nas/ pha la āḥ bar/ tshogs bsgrigs las/ sems can thams cad= nas/ sngon gtor/ bgegs gtor/ rakṣaṃ hūm̐: bar/ spro na mngon rtogs las/ bdag nyid rgyu'i he ru ka'i thugs kar pam̐ las= sogs nas/ thal ba'i rdul du brlag par gyur: tshangs sgra'i/ hrīḥ sa bon hūm̐ las= sogs nas phyi nang gsang mtshams/ ku ru hūm̐: bar/ mnga' gsol rgyan btags gong du ma song na 'dir bya ba yin/ pra khrid dam chog bsgrigs ltar/ brda sgo/ brda phyag dam bca'/ byin 'bebs rnams sbyar/ de nas tshangs sgra'i/ tshogs zhing*/ 338) badzra akṣa= nas/ rgyun bshags/ sman raka gtor ma/ dzñā na dhārtu āḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gdal khyab= nas/ sa ma ya hrīḥ bar/ de nas bdag bskyed lus dkyil me phreng ltar ni/ bhrum̐:'byung ba me rlung= nas/ ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐: bar/ mdun bskyed tshangs sgra'i/ eḥkun bzang mkha' klong= nas/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: bar/ bum bskyed chog bsgrigs ltar/ oṃ badzra yakṣa= nas/ mngon rtogs dang gab sprad dam/ zur byang sbyar te/ rang 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ las bum mi dgos/ mngon rtogs kyi/ de ltar gsal ba'i= sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs/ thugs dam kyi rgyud bskul: tshangs sgra'i spyan 'dren nas/ bstod pa yan/ 'dir bdag bskyed dang bum bzlas cung zad thog sgo zhus/ mtshams gcod nas 'jug pa'i chos rdzogs nas dam tshig rnam bshad rjes su dzapra la 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs bcas zin nas dam tshig bsgrags/

bzung bar 'dir blang ba yin yang lag len bde khyad kyi dbang gis skabs su 'og tu 'byung*/ maṇḍal gsol 'debs rgyas pa phur tshugs bcas/ bya khyung bdag bskyed bsnyen dmigs/ lha rnams kyi gnas gsum du= nas/ 'gyur ba hūm̐ mthing du dmigs= bar/ rdor bzlas cung zad dang*/ dzapra dgongs las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bskul lo bskul lo= nas/ mdzad du gsol: ging gi bdag nyid lha yi= sogs nas yig chen gzhung rgyug gam/ spro na/ bdag nyid gtso mchog padma badzra gyi thugs kyi rtse mo= gur phub pa lta bu'i gzhal yas khang nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su padma dmar po hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa 339) de yi phyi rol du= gtso bo'i sngags/ zhes pas bskor ba 'od dmar po'i rang gzhin zla ba nya rgyas pa= bskor bar dmigs/ bar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ pho brang dbus nas= nas/ mi btang ngo: gtso sngags/ pho brang shar phyogs buddha thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs kyi rtse mo= nas/ gur phub pa lta bu'i gzhal yas khang nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su 'khor lo dkar po oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa de yi phyi rol du/ sngags/ zhes pas bskor ba 'od dkar po'i rang bzhin zla ba nya rgyas pa= sogs nas/ bskor bar dmigs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ pho brang shar nas= sogs sngags brgya/ pho brang lho phyogs mi skyod rdo rje'i thugs kyi= sogs/ 'od zer ser po= nub phyogs padma dbang chen rtsal gyi= 'od zer dmar po'i= byang phyogs rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal gyi= 'od zer ljang gu'i= shar lho mdog dmar me phreng gi= 'od dmar po'i= lho nub sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i= 'od mthing nag gi= nub byang dpal chen rta mgrin gyi= 'od dmar nag gi= byang shar lag na rdo rje'i= 'od sngon po'i rang bzhin= zhes kha bsgyur ba'i dzapra dmigs re dang dzapra skul re sbrags nas/ gtso brgyad snyen pa brgya re/ phyi 'khor dzapra dmigs dang dzapra'i bskul gnyis/ bsnyen pa lnga bcu/ gong gi bdag nyid lha'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'khor lo las=

nas/ zhugs pa can gyi 'khor lor dmigs/ tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dur khrod gsang chen= sogs nas/ bsgrub par bya: spyi dril 'bring 340) po gsum brgya/ mngon rtogs las/ lha tshogs gtso 'khor= nas/ 'grub par 'gyur: dzapra dgongs las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings mtha' dbus= nas sku gsum dzapra bskul/ mi btang ngo: spyi dril chen mo lnga bcu/ 'di nas snyen rgyun pas thun gzung*/ gong gi bdag nyid lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon las= nas/

rgya che bar sngags sgra ti ri ri grags par bsam: spyi dril chen mo lnga bcu/ bung ba tshad zhig bdag nyid lha'i= nas/ ti ri ri sgrogs par bsam: bar/ 'og gi hūm̐ hrīḥ dbang chen zla gam= nas/ mi gtang ngo: bar dang*/ spyi dril chung ba dril sgrub las gsungs pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhāe ba dhā ki nī e waṃ hrīḥm swa hā: lnga bcu bzla/ tse le'am bya khyung gang yin gyi bum dmigs/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i= nas/ sgrog par gyur= bar dang*/ ka la ksha 'i gsham can bzla/ 'dzapra dgongs gsham nas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam= sogs nas/ sarba dhā ki ni hūm̐: bar/ tse le'i dung zhal mtha' nas/ mthar lha 'od du zhu nas chu dang dbyer med du gyur pas chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ bar gtang*/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying rnams brjod nas/ tshangs sgra'i/ ye shes lha tshogs= zhes dang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ zhi ba lhun grub= mar 'don pas tshig gnyis bskyur mi dgos/ las mdzod cig bar/ nyin gzhung nyulle skrod pa ni/ e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs pa'i nang du dgra bgegs dam sri dngos su gsal bar gyur/ 341) spyi 'gugs la/ sgrub pa zab mo= sbyar/ phur thun mtshams bskul dang drag sngags so lngas thun brab/ pra khrid ltar/ hūm̐: sgrub pa lung gi pho nya= nas= phrin las mdzod: nyulle skrod sngags dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ sogs shis brjod dang*/ rig 'dzin byin 'bebs dang sgrub khog byin 'bebs/ tshangs sgra'i byin 'bebs gang mos btang*/ gzhung chen dzapra la 'jug gzhung bsrangs nas me phreng*/ kye kye:phyogs bcu'i= sogs/ pra khrid brda sgo nas/ byin 'bebs bar gtang*/ me phreng mchod rlabs nas bstod pa yan/ maṇḍal gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ dzapra dgongs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bskul lo bskul lo= nas/ mdzad du gsol: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dur khrod gsang chen= nas/ bsgrub par bya: sngags grangs snga dro ltar la/ gtso dgu brjod/

spyi dril che 'bring chung gsum/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying*/ ye shes lha tshogs= tshangs sgra ltar/ dge bsngo/ 'di ltar bskyed rdzogs= thun gsum pa de ltar grub nas/ rta sha btsan rgod chags med gsung*/ me phreng tshogs dang skong ba chags med gsung*/ drang ba/ lhag ma/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ chad mdo/ brtan ma/ nyulle'i skul pa/ gnam lha lcam mo dang mtshan kyi sngags bcas gtang*/ bro mnan/ phyag 'tshal brgya rtsa'i mchod pa dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi bde rol lam/ bstod 'bum ltar dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs kyis bstod/ nongs bshags bkra shis/ bsdu rim/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ grol bar shog: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= bzlas pa la bzhugs/ thun 'jog ran dus gzhung chen pas/ ye shes lha tshogs= 342) stong tshig bya/ gter chen rgyun khyer ram/ chags med rtsa tshig lta bu btang nas/ ༈ dzapra dmigs yid yul du gsal bas ngag 'don med kyang chog spyi dril 'bring po la thun bzung*/ mchod stod spyi ltar/ gzhung bsrong pas/ me phreng skyabs sems nas nyin thun ltar la/ dzapra dgongs/ bskul lo bskul lo= dor kyang chog gtso dgu sogs snyen pa nyung tsam/ ye shes lha tshogs= kyi bstod/ mtshan thun gsum la de ltar ro/ de nas phyir nangs phan zhag grangs ma rdzogs bar/ hrīḥ sngon gyi= spos phyung*/ tshangs sgra'i skyabs sems dang*/ sngon gtor dor nas bgegs gtor phyin chad snga nyin ji lta ba las/ nyin gnyis par las byang gi sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs tshab tu/ mchod sprin/ hūm̐: lha tshogs mchod pa'i= sogs nas/ hūm̐ swa hā: bar gtang*/ tshangs sgra'i phyi mchod byin rlabs/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs= phyin chad 'dra/ gzhung chen snyen pa la slebs dus/ bsnyen rgyun pas mchod bstod dang*/ me phreng dbu nas bstod pa yan/ tshangs sgra'i dzapra skul rjes/ gtso dgu bka' bsdod bcas bsnyen pa khyug tsam rjes spyi dril che 'bring gang mos thun gzung*/

nyin gsum par/ bdag bskyed me phreng dor nas/ tshangs sgra rang gzhung*/ hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: bar/ mngon rtogs las/ bdag nyid rgyu'i he ru ka= sogs nas/ gar byed pa'o: bum bskyed man dngos gzhi'i nyin dang po bzhin/ nyin bzhi par/ bdag mdun bum bskyed nyin dang po ltar la/ tshangs sgra'i phyag 'tshal zin nas mchod phreng gi 343) hūm̐: bdud rtsi 'jam legs= sogs nas/ bar gyi bstod pa rnams bskyur nas/ nyer spyod/ 'dod yon rig ma lnga bcas zin nas/ maṇḍal tshul bdun ltar/ tshig lhug tshigs bcad spel ma tshan gsum dang*/ mchod phreng gi rgyal srid/ rtags brgyad bcas tshar nas/ tshangs sgra'i sman raka man nyin dang po bzhin/ nyin lnga par/ tshangs sgra'i phyi nang gsang mchod tshar nas/ mchod sprin gyi/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas= sogs/ ka ma la ya st+wam̐: bar/ mngon rtogs kyi/ gtor mgron gyi lha tshogs= sogs/ sngags bsngo/ khā hi= bar/ bya khyung pa'i/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud= sogs nas/ shin tu rnal 'byor= zhes pa'i 'phros su/ gtso dgu'i rang sngags la/ khā hi: sbyar/ chog bsgrigs mtshan don 'phros/ khyad par du'ang bde gshegs= sogs nas/ bka' srung mtha' bar/ mngon rtogs 'phros/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= nas/ 'grub mdzad gsol: sman raka mchod sprin gyi brjod pa tshig gi bsngo ba/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog= sogs nas/ de mur/ hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i gter chen= sogs nas/ kha raṃ khā hi: bar/ mngon rtogs las/ sa hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas= sogs nas/ 'grub par mdzod: bar/ sman raka bshams nas/ skyes bu chen po des ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin gtor mas dgyes shing tshim par gyur cig: gong ga ི sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang= nas gyur cig: bar/ tshangs sgra'i gzhung bstod man 'dra/ nyin drug par/ 344) tshangs sgra'i sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa gzhung rgyug tshar nas bstod 'bum chen mo'i/ hūm̐ hrīḥ zla gam dbang chen= nas/ thugs dam can rnams bstod:

bar/ 'og gi dus gsum bde gshegs= nas/ gar bsgyur mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ gong ga ི hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams dang= nas/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho= yan shlau ka gcig de nas 'og gi dad cing gdung bas= nas/ slob par shog: bar/ gsol 'debs/ dzapra gzhung srong ltar ram snga nyin rnams ltar la/ byin 'bebs 'phros su/ tshangs sgra'i dngos grub skul pa/ hūm̐:bde mchog bde spyod= nas/ a la la ho: bar/ sman mchod byas la/ siddhi pha la a la la ho: bdud rtsir rol/ phyi thun man 'dra/ nyin bdun par/ phyi thun gnyis snga char grub nas/ bka' srung rta nag gi mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar/ sha za/ btsan rol bcas zin nas/ tshogs ni/ tshangs sgra'i/ e ma ho= sogs las rdor kyis zhu ba la slob dpon gyis lan gdab/ las rdor gyis bgegs bskrad zhu/ 'dus pa rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbighnan= sogs/ che ge'i mal du/ tshogs mchod rlom pa'i g.yo mo so can la sogs 'byung po gtor ma za ba thams cad bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes sbyar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'dod yon rol pa= nas/ rdzas su gyur : bar/ mngon rtogs las/ tshogs snod kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi= nas/ bslad med pa ltar gyur: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nas/ ha ho hrīḥ 345) zhes pa'i mtshams su bya khyung pa'i tshogs spyan 'dren sbyar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla med= nas/ tshogs 'bul dang*/ gzugs la bstim mtshams su/ spyi 'gugs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos nyid= nas bsgral stab/ mchod pa'i mthar/ yaṃ skang gnyis/ bshags pa/ skong ba'i bar song nas/ brgyud skong dang*/ mdangs skong chen mo/ bka' srung skong ba bcas sbyar/ hoḥston pa rdo rje slob dpon= sogs nas tshogs drangs ba dang*/ lhag ma yar gnas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku skye med= nas/ rgyu 'bras gcig: bar/ bya khyung las/ ya rkan yab lnga= nas/ hrīṃ dzaḥ bar/ mar gnas/ hūm̐ bhyo: dpal gyi= nas/ bhya swa hā: tshogs 'khor phul ba'i= dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ tshangs sgra'i gzhung bskul/

chad tho/ brtan ma/ bro mnan/ bdag cag yon mchod= bcas/ spro na mngon rtogs kyi/ me tog bdug spos= sogs dang*/ bde chen rol pa= sogs kyis mchod bstod dang*/ bsdu na rgyun khyer ltar/ tshangs sgra'i nang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= sogs smon lam dang*/ bdag cag ma rig= sogs dbyangs gsal yig brgya lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ rten bzhugs dang*/ gong gi bkra shis / e ma hoḥdus gsum sangs rgyas= sogs nas/ 'grub par shog: gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs pa dang*/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel= sogs bsngo ba/ rang byung= nas/ hoḥ bar/ rgyal dkyil= bcas bya'o/ dngos grub bskul ba ratna'i lugs ltar bya'o/ zur tshogs skong gso bas 346) bskang chog ji lta ba dang*/ dregs gsol bcas chad med/ rdo rje mtshams pas pra khrid ltar ram bka' brgyad ltar bya'o/ nyin brgyad par tho rengs gzhung bsrang gi las byang gsum pa dang lhan cig hrī:sngon= me phreng bgegs gtor/ srung 'khor/ tshogs bsags/ brda sgo brda phyag nas/ bstod pa'i bar/ tshangs sgra'i dzapra bskul byas la/ gtso dgu/ bka' sdod/ spyi dril che 'bring chung gsum/ bum bzlas/ ka la ksha= nas cung zad bzlas kha skong dang*/ ye shes lha tshogs kyi= mchod bstod/ chags med gtor 'bul rta sha btsan gsum/ me phreng tshogs mchod skong ba yan tshar nas/ dngos grub len chog gi tshangs sgra las/ dngos grub la= sogs drag sngags bcas bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sa bon hūm̐ las= sogs srung 'khor bsgom/ sgrub khog gi byin 'bebs/ pra khrid ltar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung gdod nas= sogs/ bla ma/ yi dam/ mkha' 'gro/ spyi bsdus kyi dngos grub bskul pa bcas/ a la la hoḥ bar/ mjug gi sngags grangs bsags la sgrub rten dang dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams zhu/ 'og gi hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas= sogs/ bkra shis dang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro= nas/ lhun grub shog: bar gyi smon lam brjod/ bdag 'jug lam 'bras dbang las/

mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs nas/ maṇḍal gsol gdab lan gsum/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar gyur: rin chen dge tshogs= sgrub dbang chen mo ni/ khrus/ sgo zhus/ lan gdab/ chog bsgrigs ltar bgegs gtor/ 347) tshangs sgra'i/ dngos grub sgrub pa= nas/ srung 'khor nang mtshams/ gsang mtshams bcas/ mtshams sbyar bcas maṇḍal/ mjug gi chos sngon du song yod na 'dir mi dgos/ sgrub chen dang 'brel dgos nges pa dngos sgrub bsgo ba'i sgrub dbang chen mo yin pas de dag nas 'jug kyang rung la/ 'jug par sngar ma song zhing rgyas par spro na/ dbang gzhung rgyun bshags nas/ gsol gdab/ gnang sbyin/ smad g.yogs/ stod g.yogs/ thor cog dar dpyangs/ dri thig dam bzhag dam chu/ mig dar/ me tog maṇḍal lan gsum/ gsol gdab nas rim par/ ye shes dbab pa'i/ dzñā na satwa 'i dzapra dbyangs lhan cig bla ma'i dmigs pa/ tshangs sgra'i bla ma'i spyan 'dren lhan 'don/ 'og gi bla ma yi dam= nas/ lhanaḥ brtan par byas/ yi dam dmigs pa/ las byang spyan 'dren/ brtan par bya/ mkha' 'gro'i dmigs pa/ spyan 'dren rdzogs par btang*/ brtan bzhugs/ dri ba/ kha dog lung bstan/ maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ mchod pa sngags rgya/ me tog dor/ slar byin cing ming btags mig dar bsal/ dkyil 'khor rnam dag bshad/ rdor dril gtod/ spro na dam tshig rnam bshad/ 'di mtshams tshogs grol na/ gtso bo ji ltar= sogs kyis grol/ yar tshogs nas thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga/ mtha' rten lnga bcas phyi phan dbang bcu/ nang rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams dbang la/ sku lha/ gsung sngags/ thugs phyag mtshan/ me tog rgyan chas/ phrin las gzhan don/ 348) rdo rje slob dpon bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang dngos/ kun bzang phyag rgya/ brda don/ dam tshig gi mtha' rten bcas/ dbang gong ma gsum/ brtul zhugs/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ dngos grub mchod rdzas kyi dbang bcas/ dngos grub bsgo ba'i sgrub dbang la/ maṇḍal/ pra khrid ltar/

ra ba thams cad kyi= sogs nas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dgos pa rgya chen po'o: bar dang*/ bkra shis/ gtso bos= maṇḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo bcas byas nas grol/ khrom dbang dgos na byin rlabs gtor ma'i brda dbang bskur/ de nas/ me phreng ltar tshogs drangs ba/ lhag ma bcas las byang tshangs sgra'i lhag ma'i rjes su yod pa'i bstod pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ skye med rnam dag= nas/ bstsal du sol: bar*/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ bskul 'bum chen mo mthar chags su btang ba las/ hrīḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa= sogs kyi gong du/ rta mgrin bskul pa sbyar/ bskul 'bum tshar nas/ me phreng chad tho/ tshangs sgra'i chad tho'i gong gi hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas rnam dag= nas/ cham la phob: bar/ rta mgrin las/ hrīḥ dbang chen 'bar ba= nas/ med par mdzod: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam= nas/ 'grub par mdzod: zor du 'phangs nas me phreng ltar/ brtan ma/ bro mnan rjes su/ me phreng ltar gyi mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ dngos su byor bshams= nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba yan dang*/ dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs= sogs 349) bstod 'bum ltar dang*/ tshangs sgra'i/ bde mchog bde spyod= sogs kyis dngos grub blangs/ pra khrid gter sba/ oṃ bhrum̐: lha ma'i= nas/ sgrol bar shog: bar/ me phreng nongs bshags mtha' bsdu/ phyir nyin me phreng las byang gzhung rgyug tshogs bskang lhag ma/ bskul/ chad brtan/ bro mnan/ dngos grub/ blang ba yan grub nas/ mtha' brtan byin rlabs gtor ma'i brda dbang la/ khrus bgegs bskrad srung 'khor gnam chos ltar/ maṇḍal/ gsol gdab nas/ byin 'bebs/ sgrub gtor gnas lngar gzhag dkar rgyan gyis rgyas gdab*/ bdud rtsi blud/ rdor dril rgyas gdab rjes kyi las rim/ rtogs pa brjod cing= sogs nas/ shes par bya'oḥ bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ bdag cag ma rig= sogs nas/ rab tu bshags: bar/ rta mgrin las/ gang yang bdag blo= yig brgya/ me phreng ltar gtor ma byin rlabs dang*/ khā hi'i sngags bsngos/

mngon rtogs gsham gyi/ hrīḥ bde bar gshegs pa= nas/ siddhi hrīḥ bar/ gtor dbang mjug g-i sngags rjod bzhin sgrub gtor bkye/ rta mgrin las/ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings kyi= sogs bkra shis brjod/ gtor dbang bsham/ gtor dbang ma bskur na= sogs nas/ gud du phyes pa'o: dam tshig 'dus blangs/ maṇḍal/ lus 'bul bcas/ rdul tshon la ye shes par tshangs sgra'i gshegs gsol/ ras bris la rten bzhugs/ dam tshig pa pra khrid ltar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam= nas/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa phaṭa ཿ snang srid 'khor 'das 350)

nas/ brdal bar bya'o: bar/ me phreng las/ snod bcud skye 'gro= nas/ mjal bar gyur: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ e ma hoḥ dus gsum= nas/ 'grub par shog: bar/ pra khrid las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mi gnas= sogs nas/ nongs bshags/ hūm̐ hrīḥ thams cad rdo rje= sogs dang*/ spro na/ ye shes sku mchog= yig brgya tshar gsum/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bka' drin 'khor med= sogs dang*/ yig brgya/ maṇḍal/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes 'od lnga= sogs nas/ myur thob shog: slob dpon gyis/ mi gnas ye shes= sogs dang*/ mched lcam slob ma rnams kyi= sogs nas/ 'khod par dmigs/ gtong thun bcas/ mar me'i smon lam mtha' bar/ maṇḍal smon lam tshan gsum 'dir bya/ tshangs sgra'i/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= nas/ grol bar shog: bar/ pra khrid las/ e ma ho: rang byung rnam dag= nas/ ma bral ba'i ngang la spyod lam thams cad bya'o: bar/ de nas rgyal tho la/ tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'das dang= sogs/ grogs mdzod cig: bar dang*/ sgo byang la/ pra khrid kyi/ hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi mtshams= nas/ bzlog tu gsol: bar dang*/ khro bcu'i sngags la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra dunti mi li mi li ye swa hā: btags la phur rtse bkru/ dbyangs rol mo dang bcas te/ bkra shis bde legs rgya mtsho= sogs/ brjod/ maṇḍal/ mngon rtogs/ tshangs sgra gsum gyi bsngo ba rnams rim bzhin byas pas legs par grub po// de nas du ba mthong grol/ 351) chu bo mthong grol sogs gzhan sgrub pa'i cha lag rnams gsang ba spyi'i 'gros ltar bya'o// padma'i thugs bcud zab gsang snying po'i phul// 'di la brten nas mchog dngos yid bzhin 'grub// rang gzhan 'brel bcas rnga yab dpal gyi rir/ khyab bdag padma nyid dang dbyer med shog zhes pa'ang rang gi 'dun pa chen pos sngon byon dam pa'i lugs srol rang bzo'i dri mas ma sbags par dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal lam padma kun bzang bstan 'dzin nor bus bris pa dge legs 'phel/ 'di la bca' gshom sogs kyi lag len zur du yod do//
